SET_LIGHT_MODE.description: Remap on 0->1 and off 1->0; keep auto=2 and remove strobe.

LIGHT_BRIGHTNESS.description: Replace the percentage slider with off/on/auto using 0/1/100, or SET_LIGHT_MODE using 0/1/2.

SET_PEDALS_MODE.description: Establish hard/soft meanings of codes 0..2 from wheel evidence; do not infer them from TuxWheel or another brand.

SET_LED_MODE.description: Establish valid modes per model/firmware. Neither the client's 0..9 nor the encoder's byte capacity proves valid options.

SET_LED_STROBE.description: Establish semantic strobe modes per model/firmware; byte capacity is not a valid option list.

SET_SPEED_LIMIT.description: Use the library range and retain the readiness guard for all three alarm settings.
Migrate callers to checked encoding; legacy encoding still substitutes zero for unknown companion settings.
Expose checked speed writes only after the companion alarm settings are known.

SET_ALARM_SPEED.description: Submit all three alarm values together and retain the maximum-speed readiness guard.
Migrate callers to checked encoding; legacy encoding still substitutes zero for an unknown maximum speed.
Expose checked three-threshold writes only after the companion maximum speed is known.

LOCK.description: Expose locking only after authentication and present wheel-confirmed status separately.

UNLOCK.description: Expose challenge-based unlocking; do not report success until the wheel confirms it.

SET_LIGHT_MODE.description: Remap on 0->1, off 1->0 and strobe 3->2; remove auto.

SET_PEDALS_MODE.description: Remap soft 0->2 and hard 2->0; keep medium=1. Verify model applicability before offering free=3.

SET_SPEED_LIMIT.description: Use 0..99, with zero explicitly meaning disabled tiltback; reject incompatible persisted values instead of silently clamping.

SET_ALARM_SPEED.description: Keep a preset selector rather than a km/h control; dynamic PWM tiltback requires compatible custom firmware.

SET_PEDALS_MODE.description: Remap soft 0->2 and hard 2->0; keep medium=1. Verify model applicability before offering free=3.

SET_SPEED_LIMIT.description: Use 0..99, with zero explicitly meaning disabled tiltback; reject incompatible persisted values instead of silently clamping.

SET_ALARM_SPEED.description: Keep a preset selector rather than a km/h control; dynamic-mode firmware applicability is unverified.

SET_PEDALS_MODE.description: Remap soft 0->2 and hard 2->0; keep medium=1.
Remap soft 0->2 and hard 2->0; keep medium=1.

SET_SPEED_LIMIT.description: Use the library's 5..60 km/h encoding range, not a universal 0..100 slider; model-safe limits remain unknown.

SET_ALARM_SPEED.description: Use a single threshold in 5..60 km/h, not a universal 0..100 slider.

LIGHT_BRIGHTNESS.description: No legacy V1 encoder; keep unavailable unless wheel evidence supports implementing one.

POWER_OFF.description: No legacy V1 encoder; keep unavailable unless wheel evidence supports implementing one.

SET_SPEED_LIMIT.description: Only identified P6/V9 V2 models have an encoder. Checked encoding rejects values above 655; legacy encoding can saturate. Establish safe model limits.
Expose checked speed writes only for identified P6/V9 V2 profiles; do not present encoding bounds as safe operating limits.

LOCK.description: Expose locking only after model/dialect discovery and retain P6/V9 authentication checks.

UNLOCK.description: Expose unlocking only after model/dialect discovery and retain P6/V9 authentication checks.

REQUEST_LOCK_STATE.description: Expose the V9 lock-state query only for its matching profile.

REQUEST_DIAGNOSTIC_LOG.description: Expose the P6/V9 V2 diagnostic download and surface transfer state, progress, failure, and verified bytes.

CANCEL_DIAGNOSTIC_LOG.description: Expose cancellation for an active P6/V9 V2 diagnostic-log transfer.

REQUEST_SERIAL.description: No legacy V1 query encoder; retain dialect gating unless implementation is supported by evidence.

REQUEST_FIRMWARE.description: No legacy V1 query encoder; retain dialect gating unless implementation is supported by evidence.

REQUEST_BATTERY_INFO.description: No legacy V1 query encoder; retain dialect gating unless implementation is supported by evidence.

SPEAKER_VOLUME.description: TuxWheel contains a support-gated 0..100 control, but no built-in protocol advertises it. Identify protocol/model support and wire evidence before flagging implement_library.
